1: // Pixel Runner - simple endless runner
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set canvas size to fill window
8:   const setSize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
10:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
11:     // Reinitialize background elements for new size
12:     initStars();
13:     initClouds();
14:   };
15:   setSize();
16:   window.addEventListener('resize', setSize);
17: 
18:   // Game constants
19:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
20:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
21:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
22:   const GROUND_HEIGHT = 50;
23:   const OBSTACLE_W = 30;
24:   const OBSTACLE_H = 60;
25:   const DOT_RADIUS = 8;
26:   const SPAWN_OBSTACLE_EVERY = 1500; // ms
27:   const SPAWN_DOT_EVERY = 2000; // ms
28:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
29:   // Visual constants
30:   const CLOUD_SPEED = 1;
31:   const CLOUD_COUNT = 5;
32:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
33: 
34:   // Helper to create stars
35:   const initStars = () => {
36:     stars = [];
37:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
38:       stars.push({
39:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
40:         y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT),
41:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
42:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
43:       });
44:     }
45:   };
46: 
47:   // Helper to create clouds
48:   const initClouds = () => {
49:     clouds = [];
50:     for (let i = 0; i < CLOUD_COUNT; i++) {
51:       const w = 80 + Math.random() * 120;
52:       const h = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
53:       clouds.push({
54:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
55:         y: Math.random() * (canvas.height / 2),
56:         w,
57:         h,
58:       });
59:     }
60:   };
61: 
62:   // Draw sky gradient and background elements
63:   const drawBackground = () => {
64:     // Sky gradient
65:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT);
66:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
67:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#00396b');
68:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
69:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT);
70:     // Stars
71:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
72:     stars.forEach(s => {
73:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
74:       ctx.beginPath();
75:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
76:       ctx.fill();
77:     });
78:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
79:     // Clouds
80:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
81:     clouds.forEach(c => {
82:       ctx.beginPath();
83:       ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.w / 2, c.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
84:       ctx.fill();
85:     });
86:   };
87: 
88:   // Update background elements each frame
89:   const updateBackground = () => {
90:     // Move clouds leftward
91:     clouds.forEach(c => {
92:       c.x -= CLOUD_SPEED;
93:     });
94:     // Recycle off‑screen clouds
95:     clouds = clouds.filter(c => c.x + c.w > 0);
96:     while (clouds.length < CLOUD_COUNT) {
97:       const w = 80 + Math.random() * 120;
98:       const h = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
99:       clouds.push({
100:         x: canvas.width + Math.random() * 200,
101:         y: Math.random() * (canvas.height / 2),
102:         w,
103:         h,
104:       });
105:     }
106:   };
107: 
108:   // Player state
109:   const player = {
110:     x: 100,
111:     y: 0, // will be set on start
112:     w: PLAYER_SIZE,
113:     h: PLAYER_SIZE,
114:     vy: 0,
115:     onGround: false,
116:   };
117: 
118:   // Game entities
119:   let obstacles = [];
120:   let dots = [];
121:   let stars = [];
122:   let clouds = [];
123:   let lastObstacle = 0;
124:   let lastDot = 0;
125:   let score = 0;
126:   let gameOver = false;
127: 
128:   const reset = () => {
129:     player.y = canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT - player.h;
130:     player.vy = 0;
131:     player.onGround = true;
132:     obstacles = [];
133:     dots = [];
134:     // Initialize background
135:     initStars();
136:     initClouds();
137:     lastObstacle = 0;
138:     lastDot = 0;
139:     score = 0;
140:     gameOver = false;
141:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:   };
143: 
144:   // Input handling
145:   // Set up audio context (will be resumed on first interaction)
146:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
147:   const playTone = (freq, dur = 0.1) => {
148:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
149:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
150:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
151:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
152:     osc.type = 'square';
153:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
154:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
155:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);
156:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
157:     osc.start(now);
158:     osc.stop(now + dur);
159:   };
160:   const playJump = () => playTone(440);
161:   const playCollect = () => playTone(880);
162:   const playGameOver = () => playTone(110, 0.5);
163: 
164:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
165:     if (e.code === 'Space') {
166:       // Resume audio context on user interaction
167:       if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
168:       if (player.onGround && !gameOver) {
169:         player.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
170:         player.onGround = false;
171:         playJump();
172:       } else if (gameOver) {
173:         reset();
174:       }
175:     }
176:   });
177: 
178:   // Utility
179:   const rectsCollide = (a, b) =>
180:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
181:   const circleRectCollide = (c, r) => {
182:     const distX = Math.abs(c.x - r.x - r.w / 2);
183:     const distY = Math.abs(c.y - r.y - r.h / 2);
184:     if (distX > r.w / 2 + c.r) return false;
185:     if (distY > r.h / 2 + c.r) return false;
186:     if (distX <= r.w / 2) return true;
187:     if (distY <= r.h / 2) return true;
188:     const dx = distX - r.w / 2;
189:     const dy = distY - r.h / 2;
190:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= c.r * c.r;
191:   };
192: 
193:   // Main game loop
194:   const loop = (timestamp) => {
195:     if (gameOver) {
196:       // Show game over screen
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
198:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
199:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
200:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
201:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
202:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
203:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
204:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
205:       ctx.fillText('Press Space to Restart', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 70);
206:       return;
207:     }
208: 
209:     // Clear
210:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
211:     // Update background elements (cloud movement)
212:     updateBackground();
213:     // Draw background sky gradient and stars
214:     drawBackground();
215: 
216:     // Update player
217:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
218:     player.y += player.vy;
219:     const groundY = canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT - player.h;
220:     if (player.y >= groundY) {
221:       player.y = groundY;
222:       player.vy = 0;
223:       player.onGround = true;
224:     }
225: 
226:     // Draw ground
227:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
228:     ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT, canvas.width, GROUND_HEIGHT);
229: 
230:     // Draw player
231:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
232:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
233: 
234:     // Spawn obstacles
235:     if (timestamp - lastObstacle > SPAWN_OBSTACLE_EVERY) {
236:       obstacles.push({
237:         x: canvas.width,
238:         y: canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT - OBSTACLE_H,
239:         w: OBSTACLE_W,
240:         h: OBSTACLE_H,
241:       });
242:       lastObstacle = timestamp;
243:     }
244: 
245:     // Spawn dots
246:     if (timestamp - lastDot > SPAWN_DOT_EVERY) {
247:       const dotY = canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE - 100 - Math.random() * 150;
248:       dots.push({ x: canvas.width, y: dotY, r: DOT_RADIUS });
249:       lastDot = timestamp;
250:     }
251: 
252:     // Update and draw obstacles
253:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
254:     obstacles.forEach((obs) => {
255:       obs.x -= SCROLL_SPEED;
256:       ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h);
257:       // Collision with player
258:       if (rectsCollide(player, obs)) {
259:         gameOver = true;
260:         playGameOver();
261:       }
262:     });
263:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
264:     obstacles = obstacles.filter((obs) => obs.x + obs.w > 0);
265: 
266:     // Update and draw dots (collectibles)
267:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
268:     ctx.beginPath();
269:     dots.forEach((dot) => {
270:       dot.x -= SCROLL_SPEED;
271:       ctx.moveTo(dot.x + dot.r, dot.y);
272:       ctx.arc(dot.x, dot.y, dot.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
273:       // Collect
274:       if (circleRectCollide(dot, player)) {
275:         score += 10;
276:         dot.collected = true;
277:         playCollect();
278:       }
279:     });
280:     ctx.fill();
281:     // Remove collected or off‑screen dots
282:     dots = dots.filter((d) => !d.collected && d.x + d.r > 0);
283: 
284:     // Draw score
285:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
286:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
287:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
288:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
289: 
290:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
291:   };
292: 
293:   // Start game
294:   reset();
295: })();

(End of file - total 295 lines)
</content>
